description: Chart inputs for scripts/render-engine-charts.py. One engine per chart (chart standard: OpenVINO GenAI, Cascadia, OVMS, llama.cpp and vLLM are separate engines, never merged). Point values are medians transcribed verbatim from the private lab campaign evidence; the renderer invents no numbers and has no hardcoded series data.

evidence: OpenVINO GenAI decode/prefill context sweep, 2026-09-15: MTP5 arm medians n=3 through 65,536 (prefill medians computed from the raw runs because the stored median objects omit prefill); no-MTP u4-KV arm n=1 cells at 98,304 and 131,072.
OpenVINO GenAI verified-envelope ladder, 2026-09-21: full-protocol run at 163,840 (111 generated tokens, TTFT 395.006 s, decode 14.34 tok/s; cold prefill 163840/395.006 = 414.8 tok/s).
Cascadia n=5 grid, 2026-09-11, 230 W cap: median wall decode at G128 across P128/P512/P1024, generation-length variants G64/G256 at P512, package power and Tmax per cell, quality PASS every cell.

CAM-2026-AUTOROUND-VS-EXL3 paired-cap decode cells, 2026-09-26/27: request-side post-first median rates n=3-4 per cell at 150 W and 230 W caps (MTP chunk-rate undercount caveat applies to speculative arms); arext base-run n=6 at 150 W also transcribed. W4A16 arms marked defective per qwen38-27-autoround-w4a16-v1.
provenance.supersede_reason: the 2026-09-12 boards merged three engines on one canvas, which violates the 2026-09-15 chart standard (one engine per chart series); the old files stay in docs/assets/ as evidence and the embedding pages carry SUPERSEDED notes
